thought: I implement a differential evolution (DE) optimizer with rand/1/bin strategy. The population is initialized uniformly within bounds. For each generation, each parent generates a trial vector using mutation (F=0.8) and crossover (CR=0.9). Greedy selection: if trial is better, it replaces parent. I track the global best and call report_best on each improvement. The seed is used to seed numpy's random generator. Budget is carefully tracked: I evaluate initial population points, then each trial point is evaluated only if it is feasible (after clipping). The loop stops when remaining budget is too low to complete a full generation, but I can still evaluate individual trials as budget allows. Finally, I return the best found.
